method: 4 synthetic datasets x 6 URLs x 2 fresh ORM sessions, original Flask routes/templates; SQL/ORM counters, no latency.
limitations: SQLite memory, no PostgreSQL query plans or network.
5 fixed members; orders/claims all belong to admin 1, one item per order.
Booking and linked receipt counts vary together; no actual Drive files or operations.
No events or historical fiscal years; results not directly comparable to other fixture baselines.
